searchText: 20 epochs since finality anyone monitoring / aware of potential issues? participation in mid 60s I'm curious how it correlates with the rocketpool beta. I thought it's non-custodial / decentralized? they can still set the default graffiti to something unique by non-custodial they just mean you have the option to control the withdrawal key
